priorities.heading: Getting Government Out of the Way of Job Creation
priorities.quote: In Congress, Morgan introduced the EPA Regulatory Relief Act to reduce burdensome regulations on hospitals, manufacturers, and other businesses in our area so they can grow and provide jobs.

priorities.heading: Protecting Coal and American Energy Resources
priorities.quote: Morgan is working to provide funding to revitalize coal communities by reclaiming and restoring abandoned mine sites to create jobs and increase our coal production.

priorities.heading: Securing Our Elections
priorities.quote: Morgan supports commonsense solutions to secure our elections, such as requiring voter ID, clearing the deceased from voter rolls, and requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote.

cost-of-living.heading: Getting Government Out of the Way of Job Creation
cost-of-living.quote: In Congress, Morgan introduced the EPA Regulatory Relief Act to reduce burdensome regulations on hospitals, manufacturers, and other businesses in our area so they can grow and provide jobs.

health-care.note: The site's health section is about the opioid crisis, which this issue doesn't cover.

immigration.heading: Cracking Down on Illegal Immigration
immigration.quote: Morgan is working to secure our border and crack down on illegal immigration. Morgan welcomes immigrants who want to come here legally and share in the American dream.

climate-energy.heading: Protecting Coal and American Energy Resources
climate-energy.quote: Morgan supports an “all of the above” energy approach and coal is a vital part of that plan.

priorities.heading: HEALTHCARE THAT'S CLOSE TO HOME
priorities.quote: Joy will protect rural hospitals, expand mental health and addiction treatment, and grow the healthcare workforce so every family can get quality care close to home.

priorities.heading: OPPORTUNITY FOR WORKING FAMILIES
priorities.quote: Joy will bring new industries and small business investment to the Ninth District, rebuild infrastructure like roads and broadband, and make sure every community has a fair chance to thrive.

priorities.heading: MARKET AFFORDABILITY IN SWVA
priorities.quote: Joy will fight to lower costs by holding corporations accountable, building affordable homes, and ensuring working people can keep more of what they earn each month.

cost-of-living.heading: The cost of everything keeps going up. What is your plan?
cost-of-living.quote: I am running to put real weight back on the side of working people. That means going after the price-gouging and the consolidation that lets a handful of companies set the price of your food, your seed, and your medicine.

housing.heading: MARKET AFFORDABILITY IN SWVA
housing.quote: Joy will fight to lower costs by holding corporations accountable, building affordable homes, and ensuring working people can keep more of what they earn each month.

health-care.heading: Rural hospitals keep cutting services. What would you do?
health-care.quote: A big part of this traces back to recent federal Medicaid changes that pulled billions out of Virginia hospitals starting this year. I would fight to protect that funding, because for rural hospitals it is not extra.

foreign-policy.heading: Where do you stand on AIPAC and U.S. aid to Israel?
foreign-policy.quote: We send Israel's government billions in weapons and taxpayer dollars every year with almost no conditions and no accountability, and I would end that.

climate-energy.heading: Where do you stand on data centers?
climate-energy.quote: If a project cannot run without raising your power bill, draining our water, and pocketing a tax break the rest of us pay for, then it is not a good deal for Southwest Virginia, and I will say so plainly.
